title: feat(public-pages): GET /verified email-confirmed landing (HUNT-01-124)
body:
HUNT-01-124 (agent 124) — links that leave the app and come back.

**U-HUNT01-2 — confirmation email opened on a computer ends on a blank or wrong page.** A new member signs up on the phone, opens the confirmation email on a computer and clicks Confirm. Supabase confirms the address and redirects to `tgp://verified`, which a computer cannot open, so the person sees a blank page (or, when the redirect is not allow-listed, the Site URL fallback "Coach landing page — This page isn't available", the page the owner saw at 12:46) and believes sign-up failed. Production today: `GET https://app.trygrowthproject.com/verified` returns 404 JSON.

Fix (T1: one static public page, no data read or written):
- `GET /verified` (excluded from `/api` in `src/main.ts`, same pattern as `/billing/update-card`), `src/public-pages/public-pages.controller.ts` + `renderEmailConfirmedPage` in `src/public-pages/public-pages.html.ts`.
- Copy: "Email confirmed", sign in on the phone with the sign-up email and password; Open the app (`tgp://verified`), iPhone / Android download pages, support email.
- Supabase appends the session (`#access_token=...`) or an error (`#error=...&error_code=otp_expired`) to the URL. The fragment never reaches the server, so a short server-owned inline script switches to "This link has expired or was already used" copy on an error and removes the fragment from the address bar so session tokens are not left visible. No request data is rendered. Headers: `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.
- Test: `test/hunt01-email-confirmed-page.spec.ts` (served controller, headers, copy rules, script run against a stub DOM for success / fragment error / query error / bare visit). Failing first: test commit a50d3c0b has no route (production 404 above).

Takes effect only when the owner points the redirect here (decision in ops/reports/HUNT-01-124.md): Supabase Redirect URLs gets `https://app.trygrowthproject.com/verified`, and either the Fly secret `SUPABASE_REDIRECT_URL` is set to it or Supabase Site URL is set to it. Until then nothing changes for users. `src/auth/auth.service.ts` (claimed by HUNT-02) is untouched.

Mobile companion: growth-project-mobile#413 (app `verified` route; the page's Open the app button lands there).

Size: 204 changed lines (125 test).
